articles.summary: Madrí Excepcional 0.0% to be available at venues across the UK from 3rd March The launch comes as more than half (52%) of 18–34-year-olds now moderate their alcohol consumption[1]
articles.title: Madrí Excepcional launches alcohol-free version in the on trade

articles.summary: Sharp's Brewing Co has unveiled a vibrant new look across its portfolio of award-winning ales, which includes Doom Bar Amber Ale, Sharp’s Offshore Pilsner and Sharp’s Atlantic Pale Ale, inspired by the brewery’s Cornish coastal heritage.
articles.title: Sharp's unveils new visual brand identity and launches on-trade cask quality club
